Who we are...
since 1996​

Amelia's Deli is located in the beautiful city of Gulf Shores, Alabama. We have served the Alabama gulf coast for 30 years!  Our sandwiches will fill you up and our cakes will keep you coming back! For sure one of the best lunches on Pleasure Island. We can also provide sandwich platters, or boxed lunches for your next event or meeting. We hope to see you soon!

AMELIA'S DELI

OUR STORY

Deli Menu

CAKES

When you can't just eat a slice...

The same delicious slice you ate with lunch can be ordered. That's right, the ENTIRE cake, to take to your home or event! We have so many fantastic options that you won't be able to choose just one! Since our cakes are baked with love, we do ask that you give us at least 3 days notice to ensure your cake is ready to pick up for you to enjoy!

Black Russian

A true chocolate lovers dream! Chocolate cake with vodka AND kahlua covered in chocolate fudge icing! What's not to love?

Iced Lemon Pound Cake

Classic southern pound cake with a twist

​

Beautifully baked cake with delightful lemon icing on top

Red Velvet

Frosted with cream cheese icing

Sprinkled with cake crumbs and love

Forget the typical layer version, ours is baked in a bundt pan to keep it moist

Hummingbird

Forget humming, this cake will make you sing! ​

 

Bananas, pineapple, and pecans baked into two beautiful layers.
